CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL CLOSED SESSION
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Emergency Operations Center (EOC)
  South Pasadena Fire Department
  817 Mound Avenue, South Pasadena, CA 91030

  Wednesday, May 13, 2020, at 6:00 p.m.

  NOTICE ON PUBLIC PARTICIPATION & ACCESSIBILITY

 Pursuant to Section 3 of Executive Order N-29-20, issued by Governor Newsom on
 March 17, 2020, the Special Closed Session Meeting of the City Council for May 13, 2020
 will be conducted remotely and held by video conference.

 Please be advised that pursuant to the Executive Order, and to ensure the health and safety
 of the public by limiting human contact that could spread the COVID-19 virus, the
 Emergency Operations Center will not be open for the meeting. Council Members will be
 participating remotely and will not be physically present.

 If you would like to comment on a Closed Session item, members of the public may submit
 their comments in writing for City Council consideration, by emailing them to:
 ccpubliccomment@southpasadenaca.gov. Public Comments must be received by 6 p.m.,
 Tuesday, May 12, 2020 to ensure adequate time to compile and post. Public Comment
 portion of the email is limited to 150 words. Please make sure to indicate: 1) your name; 2)
 what agenda item you are submitting public comment on, or if it is a general public comment;
 and/or 3) if you request for your public comment to be read at the meeting prior to the City
 Council recessing to Closed Session.

CALL TO ORDER:  Mayor Robert S. Joe.
ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Michael A. Cacciotti, Marina
  Khubesrian, M.D, and Richard D. Schneider, M.D; Mayor
  Pro Tem Diana Mahmud and Mayor Robert S. Joe.

  Wednesday, May 13, 2020
  Minutes of the Special Meeting of the City Council

  CALL TO ORDER

  A Special Meeting of the South Pasadena City Council was called to order by Mayor Joe on
  Wednesday, May 13, 2020, at 7: 04 p. m. The meeting was held in a virtual setting, with all
  Councilmembers attending via Zoom, and the meeting being broadcast via the Council
  Chamber, located at 1424 Mission Street, South Pasadena, California.

  A brief introduction was provide by Mayor Joe of the current protocols in place in an effort to
  prevent the spread of COVID- 19.

  ROLL CALL

  Present  via Councilmembers Cacciotti, Khubesrian, and Schneider; Mayor Pro Tem Mahmud;
  Zoom:  and Mayor Joe.

  Absent:  None

  City Staff  City Manager De Wolfe (in attendance via Zoom); City Attorney Teresa Highsmith
  Present: (  in attendance via Zoom); Fire Chef Riddle; Police Chef Joe Ortiz; and Chef City
  Clerk Ayala were present at Roll Call.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Robert Joe deferred the leading of the flag salute to Police Chef Joe Ortiz. Police Chief
  Joe Ortiz led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  SPECIAL PRESENTATION

  1.  Briefing by Congresswoman Judy Chu on National Response to COVID- 19 Pandemic

  Mayor Joe introduced Congresswoman Judy Chu.

  Page 1 of 3
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F36DFBE2- 8BAA- 469C- A18B- C528D57519EE

  Congresswoman Chu, Representing California's 27th Congressional District (in attendance
  via Zoom) provided an update on the various National responses to the COVID- 19
  pandemic.

  City Council had questions and comments for Congresswoman Chu regarding: bipartisan
  commission bills; concerns on current presidential administration; nation' s healthcare
  system; loans applicable to landlords; potential economic stimulus modifications; ways
  Cities can show support for the HEROES Act; etc.

  Congresswoman Chu responded questions and comments and added additional information.

  No public comment was submitted for this item.

  PRESENTATION

  2.  South Pasadena COVID- 19 Update

  Fire Chief Riddle provided a PowerPoint presentation on overall City update and a Fire
  Department update; Police Chief Joe Ortiz provided a verbal update for the Police
  Department; and City Manager DeWolfe provided an update from Los Angeles County
  regarding restrictions on businesses, outdoor recreational facilities, and gatherings.

  City Council had comments and questions regarding: COVID- 19 testing sites; the City' s
  COVID- 19  cases;  COVID- 19  testing  capacities;  COVID- 19  tracing  processes;
  reimbursements for City' s COVID- 19 related costs; police patrolling; mask requirements;
  unhoused residents; bike parks; etc.

  Chief Riddle, Chief Ortiz, and City Manager DeWolfe responded accordingly.

  No public comment was submitted for this item.

  ACTION/ DISCUSSION

  3.  Discussion Reeardine Regulation of Third Partv Food Delivery Services ( No Staff
  Report)

  Councilmember Khubesrian introduced the item and provided background information for
  discussion.

  City Council held discussion regarding the percentages due to the third party food delivery
  services; adoption of a percentage cap on third party food delivery services; service fee
  increases; anti -gauging; neighboring Cities with similar issues; etc.

  Laurie Wheeler, Chamber of Commerce President, spoke about local business concerns
  regarding the third party food delivery services.

  Page 2 of 3
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F36DFBE2- 8BAA- 469C- A18B- C528D57519EE

  Mayor Pro Tem Mahmud made a motion to send a letter to Supervisor Barger supporting
  the implementation of a countywide price cap on third party food delivery services fees.
  Councilmember Cacciotti made an amendment to also send the letter to the San Gabriel
  Valley Council of Governments and suggested sending a letter for an investigation on price
  gauging by third party food delivery food services.

  City Attorney Highsmith advised City Council on filing a formal complaint.

  City Council directed City Manager DeWolfe to send the letter Supervisor Barger and San
  Gabriel Valley Council of Governments supporting the implementation of a countywide
  price cap on third party food delivery service fees.

  ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Joe announced the neat regular City Council Meeting on May 20"'. There being no
  further business, at 8: 50 p.m. Mayor Joe adjourned the meeting.
